pairPrompt.title: Pair your devices
pairPrompt.body: Connect your belt and wrist band to start your checks.

checkNow.hint: A check takes about two minutes. Keep still and keep this screen open.

last.title: Last check
last.emptyBody: Your first check will show here.
last.worried: If you are worried, contact your barangay health worker or midwife.

reading.unverifiedBody: There was no wrist band reading to compare with.

check.title: Check
check.keepOpen: Keep this screen open while the check runs.

phase.contact: Checking that the belt touches your skin

prompt.adjustBelt: Move the belt so it sits snugly on your belly, then keep still.
prompt.rest: Sit or lie still for a moment. The belt waits until you stop moving.

reason.no_belt: No belt is paired yet. Pair your belt to start a check.
reason.disconnected: The {{device}} is not connected. Connect it below to start a check.
reason.charging: The {{device}} is charging. Check now is off until it is unplugged.
reason.cutoff: The {{device}} battery is too low. Charge it to start a check.
reason.exposure_cap: The belt has reached its limit for this hour. Please try again a little later.
reason.low_battery: The battery is too low for a check. Charge the device and try again.
reason.no_contact: The belt could not make good contact with your skin. Adjust it and try again.
reason.fault: The belt reported a problem. Please try again, or contact your barangay health worker.
reason.no_reading: No reading could be made. Please try again.
reason.not_allowed: This check cannot be started right now.
reason.link_lost: A device lost its connection. Connect it below and try again.
reason.clock_not_synced: The belt has not set its clock yet. Connect it again and try once more.
